frago.mission: Build the proword selection loop as one panel of the sit rep page, in order to rule every new proword in ten seconds where the record already lives.
frago.order: **Open the board, press B, rule the eight.** Each pick is three clicks and Submit. New slots: `python _tools/soi/brevity.py add <id> "<thing>" W1 … W10`, then the next sit rep carries them.
frago.default: Silence: the eight slots sit open on the panel; the next sit rep pulls nothing and rules nothing.

calls.why: MINT reads as the place words get struck; SOI and LEXICON are already taken by the card and the doctrine; CALLSIGN is a different thing.
calls.ruling: RULED 2026-09-23, Chief: "the name will be brevity." BREVITY. MINT retired from the bench. Note on the record: BREVITY was ruled 9/11 as what the SOI holds, the word list; the loop now carries the same name as the process that keeps that list. One word, two faces: the list and the pass that mints it.

calls.options: on submit (rec) · held to the next sit rep
calls.why: The grid pass showed the result on click; a held reveal adds a step and loses the ten-second scan.
calls.ruling: RULED 2026-09-23, Chief: "the reveal would be on submit." The result shows on the click, as the DARKROOM grid pass does.

calls.options: the back five never surface, they are the reserve (rec) · they surface when a front-five pick is struck · show all ten
calls.why: Five is the scan; ten is a list. The reserve refills a slot only when Chief strikes one.
calls.ruling: RULED 2026-09-23 on the recommendation: the back five never surface; they are the reserve, and one refills a slot only when Chief strikes a front-five pick.

phases.t: **Captured** — 9/6, mechanics banked: each proword slot carries a description plus a bench of up to ten candidates; the page shows five; Chief picks three of five, ranked 1st/2nd/3rd; ten slots a day; Claude's ranking sealed beforehand, revealed after Chief's submit.
**Name bench opened** — 9/6, Chief asked for a name: MINT (rec) · BREVITY · SOI · CALLSIGN · LEXICON.
**Parked** — 9/8, captured and spec-gap-queried, held with the stack.

**Gap 3 answered** — 9/10, BOLO 38's ruling that the sit rep page becomes the board settles this loop's placement question; it will run as a panel of that page rather than a page the board hands to Chief.
**Gaps 1 and 2 and the name ruled** — BREVITY · on submit · the back five are the reserve. Blocked #13 clears.

**The first build** — `_tools/soi/benches.json` (the slots, front five and reserve) · `build.py` ships the front five and the sealed three · `template.html` renders the BREVITY panel, writes `picks/<slot>` to the page's store on Submit, reveals the sealed ranking · `_tools/soi/brevity.py` lists, adds and applies · the sitrep skill gained H0.5, the pull. Published with the db capability; the board is now organization-internal by that declaration.
**The eight seed slots** — main effort · the outside read · napkin · the intel noun · syllabus · distill · grammar · the gear name. Chief's clicks.
